como_titulo: How do I leave my message?
como_intro: Messages are added with a Pull Request on GitHub. Simoneth reviews it, and once she approves and merges it, your message shows up here.
paso_1: Build your entry with the form below and copy it.
paso_2: Open data/testimonios.json on GitHub, click the pencil and paste it at the end of the list.
paso_3: Create the Pull Request and tick the consent box.
form_ayuda: This form does not send anything: it only builds the text for you to paste into your Pull Request.
form_consentimiento: I agree that my display name and my message may be published on this page and on the AcademiaQA and Simoneth Gomez websites.
privacidad_texto: Only what you write is published: your display name, your role or country if you add it, and your message. We never ask for an email, phone number or any other contact detail, and validation rejects messages that include them. Your GitHub username is visible in the Pull Request. To have your message removed, open a Pull Request that deletes it or reach out to Simoneth on social media.
